description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Sidebar' which displays a list of categories, allowing the user to filter notes by category. It receives categories, the current selected category, and a function to set the category as props. The component renders a styled sidebar with buttons for 'All Notes' and individual categories, displaying their respective counts.

methods.name: Sidebar
methods.description: React functional component rendering a sidebar with category buttons, allowing category selection.
